map.同时算毛回报率与净回报率：空置月数单独扣空置损失，持有成本不含空置损失，回本周期: Calculate gross and net yield together: vacancy months deduct vacancy loss separately, holding costs exclude vacancy loss, and payback is a static estimate only.
map.按房价、月租、空置月数与持有成本，分别估算毛回报率、净回报率和静态回本周期；明确: Estimate gross yield, net yield and static payback from price, rent, vacancy months and holding costs; financing, rent growth and sale proceeds are explicitly excluded.
map.填写房产总价（必填，大于 0）。: Enter the property price (required, greater than 0).
map.填写月租金（可为 0）与年持有成本（不含空置损失，可为 0）。: Enter monthly rent (0 allowed) and annual holding costs (excluding vacancy loss; 0 allowed).
map.填写年空置月数（0–12，可为小数）。: Enter vacancy months per year (0–12, decimals allowed).
map.读取毛回报率、净回报率、年净收益与静态回本周期，并查看计算假设。: Read gross yield, net yield, annual net income and static payback, and review the assumptions.
map.买房出租前同时比较毛回报与净回报，判断空置和持有成本的影响。: Before buying to rent, compare gross and net yield to see the impact of vacancy and holding costs.
map.比较不同房源的回本周期，作为初筛参考。: Compare payback periods across properties as an initial screen.
map.做敏感性讨论：空置增加、成本上升时净回报如何变化。: Run sensitivity: how net yield changes when vacancy rises or costs increase.
map.年毛租金 54 000 元；空置损失 4 500 元；有效租金 49 500 元: Annual gross rent 54,000 CNY; vacancy loss 4,500 CNY; effective rent 49,500 CNY; holding costs 15,000 CNY → net income 34,500 CNY. Gross yield 4.50%; net yield 2.88%; static payback about 34.8 years. With three vacancy months, net income is 25,500 CNY and net yield 2.13%.
map.月租 0 表示空置或免租、成本 0 表示无支出，均为合法输入；总价必须大于 0；: Rent 0 means vacant or rent-free and cost 0 means no holding expense; both are valid. Price must be greater than 0. Payback excludes financing interest, time value of money, rent growth, tax changes and sale price.
map.不会：持有成本明确不含空置损失，空置损失由空置月数单独折算。: No: holding costs explicitly exclude vacancy loss, and vacancy loss is calculated separately from vacancy months.
map.为什么回本不是精确结论？: Why is payback not a precise conclusion?
map.它是静态估算，不含贷款利息、资金时间价值、租金增长与出售价格。: It is a static estimate and excludes loan interest, time value of money, rent growth and sale price.
map.可以，表示空置或免租；总价须大于 0，空置月数须在 0–12。: Yes, meaning vacant or rent-free; price must be greater than 0 and vacancy months must be 0–12.
